faculty.name: Joshua Ackerman
faculty.summary: Studies how people detect illness in others through non-verbal cues, using behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们如何通过非言语线索检测他人的疾病状态，使用行为实验方法。

faculty.name: Omar Ahmed
faculty.summary: Studies brain and behavior relationships, focusing on addiction and memory using biopsychological methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑与行为的关系，重点关注成瘾和记忆的生物心理学方法。

faculty.name: Germine Awad
faculty.summary: Studies personality and social contexts, focusing on diversity and social transformation in psychology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人格和社会情境，重点关注心理学中的多样性和社会转型。

faculty.name: Jacinta C. Beehner
faculty.summary: Studies sexual conflict in mammalian reproduction, focusing on female counterstrategies to male reproductive tactics such as infanticide.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究哺乳动物繁殖中的性别冲突，重点关注雌性对抗雄性繁殖策略（如杀婴）的对策。

faculty.name: Animal Behavior Comparative
faculty.summary: Studies social behavior and endocrine responses in geladas and capuchins, using field and laboratory methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究黑猩猩和塞拉莱狒狒的社会行为和内分泌反应，采用实地和实验室方法。

faculty.name: Hormones Endocrinology
faculty.summary: Studies hormones and their effects on social behavior in primates using field and laboratory research.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究激素对灵长类动物社会行为的影响，采用野外和实验室研究方法。

faculty.name: Adriene Beltz
faculty.summary: Studies how hormones influence behavior across the lifespan using network analysis and longitudinal data.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究激素如何在生命周期中影响行为，使用网络分析和纵向数据。

faculty.name: Quantitative Methods
faculty.summary: Studies how children learn words from social cues, using eye-tracking and looking-time experiments with infants.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究婴儿如何通过社会线索学习单词，使用眼动追踪和注视时间实验。

faculty.name: Thore Bergman
faculty.summary: Studies social behavior and cognition in primates, focusing on dominance, vocal communication, and hormone-behavior interactions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究灵长类动物的社会行为和认知，重点关注等级制度、 vocal 交流以及激素-行为相互作用。

faculty.name: Kent Berridge
faculty.summary: Studies the neural bases of reward wanting and liking, using optogenetic and drug microinjection techniques in rodents.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究奖励欲望和喜欢的神经基础，使用光遗传学和药物微注射技术在啮齿动物中进行操纵。

faculty.name: Affective Emotional
faculty.summary: Studies the cognitive and neural mechanisms of emotional behavior in animals and humans.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究情感行为的认知和神经机制，涉及动物和人类。

faculty.name: Julie Boland
faculty.summary: Studies the cognitive processes underlying word recognition and sentence comprehension, including syntactic and semantic processing.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究单词识别和句子理解的基本认知过程，包括句法和语义处理。

faculty.name: Race Ethnicity
faculty.summary: Studies gender and feminist psychology, focusing on inclusive excellence and diversity in higher education.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究性别和女性主义心理学，重点关注高等教育中的包容卓越和多样性。

faculty.name: David Brang
faculty.summary: Studies how sensory information from one modality influences processing in another, using psychophysical testing, fMRI, and ECoG in the Multisensory Perception Lab.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究一种感觉信息如何影响另一种感觉的处理，使用心理物理学测试、fMRI 和 ECoG 在多感官知觉实验室中。

faculty.name: Rona Carter
faculty.summary: Studies how young people, especially Black girls, make sense of bodily changes during puberty in diverse social contexts, using mixed methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究青春期身体变化如何在不同社会背景下被年轻人，特别是黑人女孩赋予意义，采用混合方法。

faculty.name: Rosario Ceballo
faculty.summary: Studies how living in poverty, especially exposure to community violence, affects academic and psychological functioning of children and adolescents, using quantitative and qualitative methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究生活在贫困中的儿童和青少年，尤其是社区暴力暴露对其学业和心理功能的影响，采用定量和定性方法。

faculty.name: Edward Chang
faculty.summary: Studies predictors of psychological and physical adjustment, including optimism, perfectionism, and social problem solving, with a focus on cultural and racial factors.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究心理和生理适应的预测因素，包括乐观主义、完美主义和社会问题解决能力，重点关注文化与种族因素。

faculty.name: Tabbye Chavous
faculty.summary: Studies identity and motivation among Black youth and emerging adults, examining STEM identity development and racial climates in schools.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究黑人青少年和成年早期的身份和动机，考察STEM身份发展和学校中的种族气候。

faculty.name: Kevin Cokley
faculty.summary: Studies the impact of psychological and environmental factors on African American student outcomes, focusing on the impostor phenomenon.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究心理和环境因素对非洲裔美国学生学业成果的影响，重点关注冒充者现象。

faculty.name: Elizabeth R. Cole
faculty.summary: Studies diversity education and gender & feminist psychology, promoting social transformation in higher education.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究多元教育和性别女性心理学，促进高等教育的社会转型。

faculty.name: Terri D. Conley
faculty.summary: Studies the biological and psychological aspects of monogamy and non-monogamy, challenging traditional views.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究一夫一妻制和非一夫一妻制的心理学和生物学基础，挑战传统观点。

faculty.name: Sex Sexuality
faculty.summary: Studies the intersection of gender, sexuality, and social transformation, focusing on psychological and organizational dynamics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究性别、性取向和社会转型的交叉领域，重点关注心理和组织动态。

faculty.name: Fred Conrad
faculty.summary: Studies grief and emotional processing in relation to pop culture, using qualitative methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究流行文化对情感处理和悲伤反应的影响，采用定性方法。

faculty.name: Kai Schnabel Cortina
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural bases, focusing on attention and memory.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，重点关注注意力和工作记忆。

faculty.name: Lilia Cortina
faculty.summary: Studies political attitudes and social transformation, focusing on noncitizen voting myths and their impact on policy.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究政治态度和社会转型，关注非公民投票神话及其对政策的影响。

faculty.name: Amelia Cuarenta
faculty.summary: Studies motivation and brain mechanisms underlying educational outcomes, using psychological and neuroscience methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究动机和大脑机制对教育结果的影响，采用心理学和神经科学方法。

faculty.name: Ben Dantzer
faculty.summary: Studies the causes of variation in social behaviors and life history traits in wild animals, focusing on parental care, pair-bonding, and the effects of early life conditions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究野生动物中社会行为和生活史特征变异的原因，重点关注亲代照顾、伴侣关系以及早期生活条件的影响。

faculty.name: Pamela Davis-Kean
faculty.summary: Studies how socioeconomic status affects parenting beliefs and behaviors, using quantitative methods and longitudinal studies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会经济地位如何影响育儿信念和行为，使用定量方法和纵向研究。

faculty.name: Patricia Deldin
faculty.summary: Studies the relationship between brain, emotion, cognition, and behavior in psychopathology, particularly bipolar disorder, to develop novel treatments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究情绪、认知和行为与精神病理学之间的关系，特别是双相障碍，以开发新的治疗方法。

faculty.name: CCN Affiliate
faculty.summary: Studies decision-making and affective emotional processes using quantitative methods and social psychology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究决策过程和情感过程，使用定量方法和社会心理学。

faculty.name: David Dunning
faculty.summary: Studies how people's beliefs and preferences affect their judgments and decisions, including the impact of motivated reasoning on perception.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人们的信念和偏好如何影响判断和决策，包括动机性推理对知觉的影响。

faculty.name: Myles Durkee
faculty.summary: Studies how social contexts influence personality and identity, particularly in relation to race and ethnicity.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会情境如何影响个性和身份，特别是在种族和族裔方面。

faculty.name: Allison Earl
faculty.summary: Studies how rhetoric influences risk assessment in social psychology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究修辞如何影响社会心理学中的风险评估。

faculty.name: Ada Eban-Rothschild
faculty.summary: Studies the neuronal circuitry of sleep-wake states and sleep-preparatory behaviors using in-vivo calcium imaging, optogenetics, and chemogenetics in rodents.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究睡眠-觉醒状态和睡眠准备行为的神经环路，使用在体钙成像、光遗传学和化学遗传学技术在啮齿动物中进行.

faculty.name: Robin Edelstein
faculty.summary: Studies personality types and categorization using the Enneagram test.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人格类型和分类，使用伊涅agram测试。

faculty.name: Nicole Gardner-Neblett
faculty.summary: Studies how African American children develop complex oral language skills and their experiences in classrooms, with implications for pedagogical practices.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究非洲裔美国儿童的语言复杂性口语技能的发展及其在课堂中的经历，以探讨教学实践的影响。

faculty.name: Ashley Gearhardt
faculty.summary: Studies the addictive potential of certain foods, developing the Yale Food Addiction Scale, and how food advertising affects eating behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究某些食物的成瘾性，开发耶鲁食物成瘾量表（YFAS），以及食物广告如何影响饮食行为。

faculty.name: Susan Gelman
faculty.summary: Studies how children learn language and concepts, focusing on cognitive development and gendered language.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童如何学习语言和概念，重点关注认知发展和性别化语言。

faculty.name: Amie Gordon
faculty.summary: Studies the social cognitive, affective, and biological factors that shape close relationships, focusing on prosocial processes and their dyadic outcomes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究塑造亲密关系的社会认知、情感和生物因素，重点关注利他过程及其双人结果。

faculty.name: Arnold Ho
faculty.summary: Studies how social and political attitudes affect perception and behavior, focusing on prejudice, discrimination, and inequality.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究社会和政治态度如何影响感知和行为，重点关注偏见、歧视和不平等。

faculty.name: Luke Hyde
faculty.summary: Studies the development of risk and resilience in children, particularly antisocial behaviors and psychopathology, using neuroimaging and ecological models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童风险和复原力的发展，特别是反社会行为和心理障碍，使用神经成像和生态模型。

faculty.name: Developmental Psychopathology
faculty.summary: Studies how developmental factors influence psychopathology in adolescents, using family and cultural perspectives.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究发展因素如何影响青少年的心理障碍，采用家庭和文化视角。

faculty.name: Justin Jager
faculty.summary: Studies the development of adolescent and young adult transitions, including substance use, union formation, and the school to work transition, using sophisticated analytical methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究青少年和年轻成年人过渡期的发展，包括物质使用、伴侣形成和学校到工作过渡，使用复杂的分析方法。

faculty.name: John Jonides
faculty.summary: Studies executive control processes using neuroimaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究执行控制过程，使用神经成像技术。

faculty.name: Daniel Keating
faculty.summary: Studies adolescent cognitive, behavioral, and brain development, including neurocognitive and neuroimaging methods, to understand neurodevelopmental pathways in health risk behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究青少年的认知、行为和大脑发展，包括神经认知和神经影像学方法，以理解健康风险行为的神经发展途径。

faculty.name: Mari Kira
faculty.summary: Studies how adults maintain psychological well-being during adversities, focusing on growth from struggles and coping strategies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究成人如何在逆境中维持心理健康并从中成长，关注应对策略和资源的作用。

faculty.name: Qualitative Approaches
faculty.summary: Studies the impact of cultural and social contexts on personality and diversity in organizations using qualitative methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究文化和社会背景对个性和多样性在组织中的影响，采用定性方法。

faculty.name: Ethan Kross
faculty.summary: Studies how exercise affects emotional processing, particularly grief, using fitness classes as interventions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究运动如何影响情绪处理，特别是悲伤，使用健身课程作为干预手段。

faculty.name: Fiona Lee
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes and their neural bases, focusing on attention and memory.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知过程及其神经基础，重点关注注意力和工作记忆。

faculty.name: Taraz Lee
faculty.summary: Studies motor movement skills and cognition, focusing on executive control and motivation.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究运动技能和认知，重点关注执行控制和动机。

faculty.name: Richard Lewis
faculty.summary: Studies how artificial intelligence, particularly large language models, mirrors human cognitive processes, using these models to explore human thought and language.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人工智能，特别是大型语言模型，如何模仿人类认知过程，并利用这些模型探索人类思维和语言。

faculty.name: Cindy Lustig
faculty.summary: Studies how older adults' brains respond to attention demands using behavioral testing and fMRI, focusing on age-related changes in attention and memory.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究老年人在注意力需求下的大脑反应，使用行为测试和fMRI，关注注意力和记忆随年龄变化的特点。

faculty.name: Annelise Madison
faculty.summary: Studies the mind-brain-immune connections and develops preventative interventions for inflammatory disorders, focusing on social stress and the gut-brain axis.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究心理-大脑-免疫连接，并开发预防炎症性疾病的方法，重点关注社会压力和肠-脑轴。

faculty.name: Ramaswami Mahalingam
faculty.summary: Explores mindful leadership techniques to enhance students' leadership identities through mindfulness practices.
faculty.summary_zh: 探索正念领导技巧以增强学生的领导身份，通过正念实践。

faculty.name: Sara McClelland
faculty.summary: Studies gender and feminist psychology, personality and social contexts, and social justice.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究性别和女性主义心理学、人格和社会情境以及社会正义。

faculty.name: Kevin Miller
faculty.summary: Studies how educational methods and first impressions affect student evaluations of teachers, focusing on instruction quality.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究教育方法和第一印象对学生对教师评价的影响，重点关注教学质量。

faculty.name: Andras Molnar
faculty.summary: Studies motivated preferences for information and belief-based utility in social interactions, especially in moral behavior contexts.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究动机性信息偏好和信念效用在社会互动中的作用，特别是在道德行为情境中。

faculty.name: Christopher Monk
faculty.summary: Studies how childhood adversity affects neural development and links it to anxiety and depression in adolescents, using neuroimaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究童年逆境如何影响神经发育，并将其与青少年焦虑和抑郁症状联系起来，采用神经成像技术。

faculty.name: Donna Nagata
faculty.summary: Studies the intergenerational impacts of historical traumas, focusing on the Japanese American incarceration during World War II.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究历史创伤的代际影响，重点关注二战期间的日裔美国人拘留所事件。

faculty.name: Sheryl Olson
faculty.summary: Studies the development of self-regulatory competence in children, focusing on early precursors of disruptive behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究儿童自我调节能力的发展，重点关注早期反常行为的先兆。

faculty.name: Nansook Park
faculty.summary: Studies the development of resilience and well-being in adolescents and young adults, using longitudinal studies and surveys.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究青少年和年轻人的复原力和幸福感的发展，使用纵向研究和调查。

faculty.name: Stephanie D. Preston
faculty.summary: Studies decision-making and affective emotional processes using cognitive neuroscience methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用认知神经科学方法研究决策和情感过程。

faculty.name: Leah Richmond-Rakerd
faculty.summary: Studies emotional and behavioral dysregulation across the life course, focusing on self-regulation difficulties and their outcomes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究生命历程中的情绪和行为调节障碍，重点关注自我调节困难及其结果。

faculty.name: Deborah Rivas-Drake
faculty.summary: Studies how school, peer, family, and community settings support adolescents in navigating race and ethnicity, impacting their academic, socioemotional, and civic development.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究学校、同伴、家庭和社区环境如何帮助青少年应对种族和 ethnicity 问题，影响其学业、情感和社会发展。

faculty.name: Craig Rodriguez-Seijas
faculty.summary: Studies the impact of stigma and discrimination on psychopathology in sexual and gender minority populations, using transdiagnostic models.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究歧视和边缘化对性取向和性别少数群体心理障碍的影响，采用跨诊断模型。

faculty.name: Alexandra Rosati
faculty.summary: Studies the cognitive abilities of primates, focusing on decision-making, executive control, and social cognition in various ape, monkey, and lemur populations.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究灵长类动物的认知能力，重点关注决策、执行控制和社会认知在各种猿类、猴类和狐猴中的表现。

faculty.name: Gideon Rothschild
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain processes sound, focusing on perception and memory.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何处理声音，重点在于感知和记忆。

faculty.name: Colleen Seifert
faculty.summary: Explores ethical and equitable use of AI through interdisciplinary research.
faculty.summary_zh: 探索人工智能的伦理和公平使用问题，通过跨学科研究进行探讨。

faculty.name: Denise Sekaquaptewa
faculty.summary: Studies implicit stereotyping, prejudice, and stereotype threat, examining their effects on academic performance and motivation, particularly among women in STEM fields.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究隐性刻板印象、偏见和刻板印象威胁，探讨它们对学术表现和动机的影响，尤其是对STEM领域女性的影响。

faculty.name: Robert Sellers
faculty.summary: Studies inclusive psychology and its impact on diverse student experiences.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究包容性心理学及其对多样化学生体验的影响。

faculty.name: Isis Settles
faculty.summary: Studies the experiences, perceptions, and coping strategies of devalued social group members, particularly Black people and women, using an interdisciplinary, intersectional framework.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究被贬值社会群体成员（尤其是黑人和女性）的经历、感知和应对策略，采用跨学科和交叉学科的框架。

faculty.name: Priti Shah
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive processes, including attention and memory, using behavioral experiments.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知过程，包括注意力和记忆，使用行为实验方法。

faculty.name: Kristina O. Smiley
faculty.summary: Studies brain and behavior relationships, focusing on hormones and animal behavior.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑与行为的关系，重点关注激素和动物行为。

faculty.name: Catherine Thomas
faculty.summary: Studies motivation and social psychology in organizations, using interventions and cultural approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究组织中的动机和社会心理学，采用干预和文化方法。

faculty.name: Natalie Tronson
faculty.summary: Studies the molecular mechanisms of learning and memory, focusing on how neuroimmune signaling and stress affect memory formation and reconsolidation, particularly in post-traumatic stress disorder.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究学习和记忆的分子机制，特别是神经免疫信号和压力如何影响记忆的形成和重新巩固，特别是在创伤后应激障碍和术后认知衰退中的作用。

faculty.name: L. Monique Ward
faculty.summary: Studies the development of sex, gender, and race identity in adolescents using psychological methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究青少年性别、性别认同和种族身份的发展，使用心理学方法。

faculty.name: Felix Warneken
faculty.summary: Improves human-AI teamwork in manufacturing by helping AI recognize and repair breakdowns in human intent recognition.
faculty.summary_zh: 改善制造中的人工智能团队合作，通过使人工智能能够识别和修复人类意图理解中的故障。

faculty.name: Daniel Weissman
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive control and executive functions, focusing on how people manage their attention and actions.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究认知控制和执行功能，关注人们如何管理注意力和行为。

faculty.name: Aidan Wright
faculty.summary: Studies personality and its relation to psychopathology using ambulatory assessment and advanced quantitative methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究人格及其与心理障碍的关系，使用流动评估和高级定量方法。

faculty.name: Laura Zahodne
faculty.summary: Studies how psychosocial factors influence cognitive and brain aging in late life, with a focus on racial/ethnic disparities and positive social networks.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究心理社会因素如何影响晚年认知和大脑老化，重点关注种族/民族差异和积极的社会网络。

faculty.name: Jun Zhang
faculty.summary: Studies perception and decision-making using computational models and neural network theory.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究知觉和决策制定，使用计算模型和神经网络理论。

faculty.name: Anuska Andjelkovic-Zochowska
faculty.summary: Studies the genomic revolution in oncology, focusing on MiOncoSeq technology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究基因组革命在肿瘤学中的应用，重点是MiOncoSeq技术。

faculty.name: Pierre Apostolides
faculty.summary: Studies how the brain uses prior knowledge to guide auditory function and motor actions, focusing on synaptic plasticity and neural circuits during hearing loss.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑如何利用先验知识指导听觉功能和运动行为，重点关注听力损失期间的突触可塑性和神经环路。

faculty.name: Sara Aton
faculty.summary: Studies how sensory experience and sleep affect neural circuits, contributing to nervous system plasticity and memory formation.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究感觉经验与睡眠对神经回路的影响，促进神经系统可塑性和记忆形成。

faculty.name: Victoria Booth
faculty.summary: Studies neural circuits and sleep in rodents and humans, using computational models and electrophysiology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究啮齿动物和人类的神经回路和睡眠，使用计算模型和电生理学方法。

faculty.name: Steven Broglio
faculty.summary: Studies mild traumatic brain injury prevention, biomechanics, assessment, and treatment in athletes.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究运动员轻度创伤性脑损伤的预防、生物力学、评估和治疗。

faculty.name: Tim Bruns
faculty.summary: Studies neural interfaces with dorsal root ganglia and controlling autonomic organ function using closed-loop neuroprostheses.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究与脊神经节连接的神经接口以及控制自主器官功能，使用闭环神经假体。

faculty.name: Cindy Chestek
faculty.summary: Develops brain-machine interfaces to enable paralyzed individuals to control prosthetic limbs and their own limbs using neural activity and functional electrical stimulation.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发脑机接口以使瘫痪个体能够通过神经活动和功能性电刺激控制假肢和自身肢体。

faculty.name: Josie Clowney
faculty.summary: Studies how neural circuits in fruit flies are organized to process chemosensory information for instinctual behaviors versus learning, using genomic and developmental approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究果蝇中化学感觉电路的组织方式，如何处理本能行为与学习之间的化学感觉信息，采用基因组和发育方法。

faculty.name: Gabriel Corfas
faculty.summary: Studies the cellular and molecular mechanisms of brain development, plasticity, and hearing loss, with a focus on noise-induced and age-related hearing loss and social isolation effects.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑发育、可塑性以及听力损失的细胞和分子机制，重点关注噪声和年龄相关性听力损失和社会隔离对大脑结构和功能的影响。

faculty.name: Bo Duan
faculty.summary: Studies molecular and cellular mechanisms of brain development.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑发育的分子和细胞机制。

faculty.name: Eva Feldman
faculty.summary: Studies neurological diseases and therapies, collaborating with multidisciplinary teams to advance brain health research.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经疾病和治疗方法，与多学科团队合作，推进大脑健康研究。

faculty.name: Colin Greineder
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of cognitive control and decision-making in emergency medicine patients using neuroimaging.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究急诊患者认知控制和决策机制的神经机制，使用神经影像学方法。

faculty.name: Ansel Hillmer
faculty.summary: Studies brain mechanisms of pain and opioid addiction using imaging techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用成像技术研究疼痛和阿片类成瘾的认知神经机制。

faculty.name: Anthony Hudetz
faculty.summary: Studies state-dependent cortical information processing during wakefulness and anesthesia using high-density microelectrode arrays.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用高密度微电极阵列研究清醒和麻醉状态下皮层信息处理的状态依赖性。

faculty.name: Chandramouli Krishnan
faculty.summary: Develops rehabilitation methods for neurologic and orthopedic disorders using low-cost robots and advanced biomechanical and neurophysiological techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发神经和骨科疾病康复方法，使用低成本机器人和先进的生物力学及神经生理学技术。

faculty.name: Peng Li
faculty.summary: Studies the molecular and neural basis of breathing, integrating molecular genetics and neuroscience to understand how the brain controls and responds to sensory cues and internal states.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究呼吸的分子和神经基础，结合分子遗传学和神经科学方法，理解大脑如何控制和响应感官线索和内部状态。

faculty.name: Andrew Lieberman
faculty.summary: Studies the genomic revolution in oncology, focusing on MiOncoSeq technology.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究肿瘤学中的基因组革命，重点是 MiOncoSeq 技术。

faculty.name: Jonathan Lifshitz
faculty.summary: Studies traumatic brain injury and its progression to chronic neurodegenerative disease, focusing on social impact and intervention strategies.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究创伤性脑损伤及其进展至慢性神经退行性疾病，重点关注社会影响和干预策略。

faculty.name: Zhongming Liu
faculty.summary: Develops computational models and imaging techniques to study neurological disorders, using neural engineering approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 开发计算模型和成像技术研究神经疾病，采用神经工程方法。

faculty.name: Ross Maddox
faculty.summary: Studies the neural mechanisms of hearing and speech processing.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究听觉和言语处理的神经机制。

faculty.name: Donna Martin
faculty.summary: Studies genetic conditions affecting the nervous system, including CHARGE syndrome, using stem cells and genetics.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究影响神经系统的遗传性疾病，如 CHARGE 综合征，使用干细胞和遗传学方法。

faculty.name: Xander Nuttle
faculty.summary: Studies genetic bases of neurodevelopmental disorders and uniquely human traits using CRISPR and cerebral organoids.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经发育障碍和人类特有特征的遗传基础，使用CRISPR和脑类器官技术。

faculty.name: Mark Peterson
faculty.summary: Studies physical rehabilitation and healthcare policy, focusing on digital health innovations and global health equity.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究物理康复和医疗保健政策，重点关注数字健康创新和全球健康公平。

faculty.name: Yujuan Su
faculty.summary: Studies how the lung communicates with the brain to regulate airway function and systemic responses, using neural circuit mapping and genetic techniques.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究肺与大脑之间的交流如何调节气道功能和全身反应，使用神经回路映射和遗传技术。

faculty.name: Michael Vesia
faculty.summary: Studies brain network dynamics in cognition, perception, and movement after brain injuries and neurological disease, using non-invasive brain stimulation.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究脑损伤和神经性疾病后认知、知觉和运动的脑网络动态，使用非侵入性脑刺激方法。

faculty.name: Michael Wang
faculty.summary: Studies the molecular and cellular mechanisms of neural plasticity and cardiovascular function.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究神经可塑性和心血管功能的分子和细胞机制。

faculty.name: Alexander Weigard
faculty.summary: Studies cognitive and neural risk factors for attention problems and substance use disorders using computational and network modeling methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 使用计算和网络建模方法研究注意力问题和物质使用障碍的认知和神经风险因素。

faculty.name: David Williams
faculty.summary: Studies various biomedical challenges, fostering interdisciplinary collaboration for medical breakthroughs.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究生物医学挑战，促进跨学科合作以实现医学突破。

faculty.name: Kelly Whiteford
faculty.summary: Studies auditory and visual perception, using cognitive and brain sciences methods.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究听觉和视觉感知，使用认知神经科学方法。

faculty.name: Yang Xiao
faculty.summary: Studies brain cell communication and spatial organization using spatial technologies and multi-modal datasets.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究大脑细胞间的通讯和空间组织，使用空间技术和多模态数据集进行功能解释。

faculty.name: Michal Zochowski
faculty.summary: Studies mechanisms of spatiotemporal patterns in coupled dynamical systems and their role in brain information processing, using both theoretical and experimental approaches.
faculty.summary_zh: 研究耦合动力系统中时空模式的形成机制及其在大脑信息处理中的作用，采用理论和实验方法相结合的研究方法。
